newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania 91-day T-bill issue fully subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Romania 91-day T-bill issue fully subscribed.

text.p: An issue of 116.14 billion lei Romanian three-month treasury bills was fully subscribed on Thursday, with bids matching the Finance Ministry's offer, latest central bank data showed.
The T-bills, with an annual yield of 49.48 percent, mature on March 13, 1997.

Banca Romana de Comert Exterior Bancorex SA, Banc Post SA, Casa de Economii si Consemnatiuni, Banca Ion Tiriac SA, Banca Romana pentru Dezvoltare SA and Fondul de Garantare a Depozitelor bought the papers.
